name: AIHOT News
tagline: Query AIHOT news and briefs through its public read-only HTTP API
description: The official AIHOT skill provides instructions for reading Chinese AI news, recent search results, hot topics, story timelines and daily/weekly/monthly briefs via curl. It reads the public HTTP API directly, requires curl, and does not require an API key or MCP installation. AIHOT is a news aggregator, not a publisher of original reporting. Canonical skill source: https://github.com/KKKKhazix/khazix-skills/tree/main/aihot. The skill files are MIT licensed; hosted content follows https://aihot.news/terms.

install.notes: Requires curl. No account or API key is required. Preserve original-source links when citing results. Hosted content is subject to https://aihot.news/terms.
